scope: pooler M32 (1,8,16,1) and qkv M32 (1,4,8,4) with v18s RT=2 (32 rows per CTA, x registers reused across 2 row tiles), ST 2 and 1

kill_rule: oracle: must recover >= 0.5 us on pooler M32
